scope: Mainline candidates after position screen; not a promise of positive outcomes
preserve: Original 500 answers and frozen full test outputs
All previous negative candidates and unused reserves

candidates.problem: Original positive class combines lexical reflection markers with low arithmetic confidence, whereas the controller observes confidence and local variance. Lexical onset identity can dominate first-content states.
candidates.mechanism: Restrict both classes to nonlexical steps: positive is confidence below original q25; negative above original q75. Estimate pooled difference at original first-content layer21, normalize to original raw norm. Only class membership/vector orientation changes; same fixed dynamic parameters, layer and injection positions.
evidence: Original calibrate_auto.py prepare/fit and existing label audits confirm the mixed label definition.
ReflCtrl 2512.13979v2 section4.2 and appendixD distinguish uncertainty association, keyword onset and imperfect labels; they do not establish that our confidence-only vector improves compression.
candidates.implementation: CPU-only from original saved first-content states; no new replay/calibration generations; existing vector-only runtime.
candidates.cost: Seconds locally plus one fresh 2x100 generation screen, estimated6-12GPUminutes including startup.
candidates.supports: Stable direction and a >=5% decrease in BOTH mean thinking and total tokens, correct count >= fresh original, caps <= fresh original.
candidates.rejects: Failure of CPU gate or generation gate stops this exact candidate; no strength/label threshold sweep.
candidates.confirmation: Only after passing, freeze asset then fresh paired 200 separately reserved train questions; single run, no selection on confirmation.

candidates.problem: Current controller sets displacement from probability summaries without checking the actual latent state being moved. An already low-positive-score state can be pushed beyond the calibrated negative centroid.
candidates.mechanism: Fit a fixed diagonal-Fisher readout at the actual predecessor input states; retain original direction d. For original negative c, cap its magnitude at max(0,(w dot h - w dot mean_under)/(w dot d)); positive c unchanged. This bounds movement in the chosen readout only, not semantic damage. No layer/strength search.
candidates.implementation: Needs a batched GPU readout and per-state clipping that works inside the current graph and KV replay; validate disabled identity, finite precision, no sign flip and no readout overshoot before generation.
candidates.cost: CPU fitting plus small deterministic GPU kernel/graph checks, then fresh2x100 if feasible.
candidates.supports: Same5%token/accuracy/cap screen gate; also no costly CPU synchronization per token.
candidates.rejects: Unstable readout, negligible interventions, runtime incompatibility, or failed generation gate.
candidates.status: mechanism fixed; online implementation design pending

candidates.problem: Long tails may continue after an answer becomes usable; saved traces do not show what the model would answer if thinking stopped at that prefix.
candidates.mechanism: Acquire bounded prefix-only forced-answer probes from saved original calibration answers without regenerating them, then test a fixed sparse online policy only if accurate stopping decisions and real probe/replay costs justify it. Exact token prefixes and intervention history must be preserved.
evidence: Prior When Does Learning to Stop Help fulltext and current Answer Convergence/Entropy Dynamics reading queue.
candidates.status: No threshold or generation batch authorized by this provisional mechanism description; first complete paper/code and CPU resource design. User eight-hour research authorization still applies once concretely fixed.
candidates.rejects: Insufficient counterfactual safety evidence, excessive probe/prefix cost, or no faithful dynamic continuation implementation.
